summary: Completed testing of Payment Reminder functionality with Stripe and PayPal payment links. All backend APIs working correctly. Fixed incorrect success URL path in generate_remaining_payment_links function.
passed_tests: GET /api/admin/pending-reminders returns list of pending reminders
Pending reminders only contain deposit_paid bookings
Pending reminders contain all required fields (id, booking_number, email, hotel_name, check_in, remaining_amount, days_until_checkin)
Send reminder endpoint accessible for valid bookings
GET /api/bookings/{id}/invoice returns valid PDF with correct headers
Stripe remaining session ID stored on booking
PayPal remaining order ID stored on booking
Stripe status endpoint handles remaining payment metadata
Admin bookings endpoint returns all required data
Bookings have all required fields for reminder email
Admin Reminders page loads correctly with table and 'Senden' buttons
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: generate_remaining_payment_links() was using /confirmation instead of /booking/confirmation for success URLs
Pending reminders correctly filters bookings within 42 days (6 weeks) of check-in
Payment reminder email includes Stripe link, PayPal link, and invoice download link
ConfirmationPage correctly handles payment_type=remaining for both Stripe and PayPal returns

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Admin Reminders page and ConfirmationPage working correctly)

seed_data_creation: Used existing test booking HBH-20260428-2DDBFA with deposit_paid status
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment reminder functionality fully tested. The test booking (HBH-20260428-2DDBFA) has check-in date 2027-02-25 which is >42 days away, so it won't appear in pending reminders. To test the 'Senden' button, create a booking with check-in within 42 days. The generate_remaining_payment_links function creates both Stripe and PayPal payment links and stores session/order IDs on the booking. Email is sent to real address max.arnim@t-online.de.
rca_of_the_issue: Found and fixed incorrect URL path in generate_remaining_payment_links(): success URLs were using /confirmation instead of /booking/confirmation. This would have caused 404 errors when users returned from Stripe/PayPal after paying remaining balance.
